description: This verifies that a user can inspect a target site in the popup, run a manual audit, and see the resulting health score, Core Web Vitals telemetry, and DOM diagnostics.
category: Core Web Vitals and DOM Diagnostics

steps.description: Fill in the manual target URL field with a valid website URL
Verify a health score is displayed
Verify Core Web Vitals telemetry is displayed
